instruction.name: vmuh.hu
instruction.description: Multiply corresponding unsigned 16-bit elements in `a` and `b`, save the upper half of the double-width product in `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 4.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
